messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a compact signature-rotation + operator-handshake for on-prem bundles so customers can rotate signing keys without re-publishing big artifacts. sketch below.

jon: Sounds useful. What prevents a partial apply where some chunks validate under old key and others under new key?

maria: Plan: bundle includes a tiny rotation envelope (active_key_id, prior_key_ids, rotation_window). Operator exposes two hooks: `/pre-activate` (fast checks) and `/finalize` (full validation). Agent must record expected key_id during staging and only accept pieces signed by that key_id.

kevin: Add TTLs for escrowed verification keys — otherwise long-lived airgapped devices pile up stale keys. propose: rotation_window + grace_period fields.

ashley: Also add an emergency admin-override flow for admins with an auditable signed token. That'll help recover bricked devices but must be logged.

maria: Example manifest snippet in plain text:
<manifest version=1 bundle_id=example-2026-01 sig_envelope={active_key_id:key-2026-02 previous:[key-2025-11] rotation_window:2592000}>
pre-activate: operator must check envelope present and that active_key_id is either in local escrow or importable by admin; if not, return a clear error.

jon: For staged/delta applies: agent should refuse chunk merges with mismatched key_id. That prevents mixed-key artifacts. Good.

kevin: Race: operator rotates escrow store while activation in flight. Suggest handshake: pre-activate returns `accepted_key_id` + `handshake_nonce`. Agent includes the nonce in finalize; mismatch -> abort and force retry.

maria: Yep — that keeps activation atomic from operator POV without long locks.

ashley: Recovery path: allow a dual-sig remediation bundle (signed by both old and new keys) for one rotation_window only. Recovery requires admin acknowledgement and will produce extra audit entries.

jon: Clarify verification rules: normal rotation accepts EITHER signature during grace window (old OR new). Recovery dual-sig requires BOTH signatures and explicit admin approval. Makes rollback safe.

ops-bot: NOTE: added to playbook: "support dual-sig recovery bundles". Tracking ticket INF-4721.

deploy-bot: CI: packaging-e2e passed for branch feature/rotation-hook (12/12) :white_check_mark:.

maria: Next steps: I'll draft a short operator API RFC with schemas for `/pre-activate` and `/finalize`, plus error codes and sample audit logs. Please add metric suggestions.

kevin: Metrics request: `rotation_attempts`, `rotation_failures_by_code`, `dual_sig_recoveries`. Ops wants these surfaced in Console.

maria: Will include metrics and a small UX note for operators about TTL handling. Thanks all :rocket:
